conceptZh: 一台小玩具機器人和一隻胖企鵝站在小彈簧床兩端，機器人只是輕輕踩了一下，胖企鵝就被彈飛出畫面；等了好久好久，企鵝才慢慢掉回來，剛好端端正正坐好。
object: a small toy robot, a chubby toy penguin and a little trampoline
morph: the glyph 跳 stands still as a solid sculpture while the trampoline gag plays out along its base
creativeAngle: 延續運動主題，笑點來自「用力極小、後果極大」的物理誇張，以及中間那段長到好笑的空白等待時間。跳為足部加兆共十三畫，字體靜止保結構，足部剛好和他學過的足互相呼應。語音詞「跳高」，跳ㄊㄧㄠˋ、高ㄍㄠ都是單一讀音，高也是同一批新字。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale mint background. One correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 跳 stands centered the whole time as a flat-fronted sculpture in saturated deep pumpkin orange, filling about 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins on all sides. Use standard textbook proportions: the 足 radical on the left and the 兆 component on the right stay clearly separated, with the two matching halves of 兆 evenly balanced and every dot readable. The glyph never moves, rotates, tilts or gets covered, and the camera stays locked. Along its base sits a small round trampoline. A chubby toy penguin stands on one end, perfectly relaxed, flippers folded. From 0.8 seconds a small boxy toy robot steps carefully onto the other end, checks his footing, and gives the gentlest possible little hop - barely leaving the surface. At 1.7 seconds the penguin is launched straight up out of frame at tremendous speed, leaving only its tiny hat spinning in the air. The robot looks up. And keeps looking up. Hold on the empty sky above the trampoline from 2.0 to 3.6 seconds, far longer than feels reasonable, while the robot slowly tilts his head further and further back. At 3.8 seconds the penguin drops back down and lands neatly sitting upright on the trampoline, entirely composed, and catches its hat. The two of them bounce out of frame together by 4.6 seconds. From 4.7 seconds to 8.0 seconds the frame is completely still and clean, holding on the single centered 跳 with nothing else in shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「跳、跳、跳高」, using the reading ㄊㄧㄠˋ for 跳 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 跳 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 跳高 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 跳: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 太空人玩偶站在「跳」字上準備起跳，卻提前飄起來，雙腳在空中亂踩。「跳」字乾脆自己往上跳，接住玩偶一起落地；玩偶愣了一下，立刻得意地敬禮。
object: An original bouncy astronaut toy with a fishbowl helmet and one solid orange 跳 sculpture.
morph: The correctly formed glyph remains intact throughout and demonstrates its meaning with one rigid upward hop, catching the drifting astronaut on its upper edge.
creativeAngle: 把原本的彈簧床彈飛橋段改成「想跳卻找不到地面」：玩偶提前失重，反而由整個字主動跳起接住它。字形全程完整，不拆筆畫；笑點結束後保留三秒以上的靜止辨字時間。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D toy animation in one locked, front-facing shot. Against a light butter-yellow background, display one correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 跳 as a saturated orange, flat-fronted solid sculpture. Its standard Traditional Chinese textbook form clearly preserves the left 足 radical and right 兆 component, with distinct strokes and open gaps. At rest, the glyph is centered, uncropped, and fills approximately 70% of frame height. Leave sufficient margins for its small vertical hop and the miniature astronaut above it. Soft studio lighting, bright matte materials, and subtle contact shadows keep the silhouette exceptionally readable.

The sole lead is an original, eager astronaut toy with stubby articulated limbs, a teal padded toy spacesuit, oversized boots, and a transparent fishbowl helmet enclosing a simple molded cartoon face. It stands on the upper edge of the right-hand 兆 component, entirely above the strokes. Its personality is all determination and misplaced confidence. The glyph itself is the only supporting object; give it personality through movement without adding a face or altering its strokes.

At the opening, the astronaut dramatically crouches for an enormous jump. By 0.9 seconds, its boots have accidentally drifted away from their foothold before it can push off. It straightens its legs with great effort but merely floats in place. From 1.3 to 2.7 seconds, it looks down and pedals its boots faster and faster, trying to find the missing foothold while remaining fully visible. Pause briefly as it freezes with both boots pointed down. At 3.0 seconds, the entire 跳 sculpture takes matters into its own hands: without bending, separating, or changing any stroke, it makes one small, crisp vertical jump. Its upper edge gently meets the dangling boot soles and carries the surprised astronaut upward. The toy flings its arms wide, then both descend together, landing softly by 4.1 seconds. The astronaut checks its planted boots, does a quick astonished double-take, and proudly salutes as though the successful jump were its own achievement. Complete this reaction by 4.7 seconds.

From 4.7 through 8.0 seconds, hold completely still: the finished 跳 is centered at approximately 70% of frame height, with the small saluting astronaut perched above its upper edge. Every stroke remains unobstructed. The jump uses only the reserved vertical margin; the camera never tracks or zooms.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly 「跳、跳、跳高」. Pronounce 跳 as ㄊㄧㄠˋ. Place the first utterance around 0.4 seconds, the second around 1.7 seconds, and the single word 跳高 around 5.5 seconds during the motionless glyph hold. Allow natural pauses and stop after the word. Use only quiet toy squeaks and a soft landing tap beneath the voice, with no music. The vocabulary is audio only. The single glyph 跳 is the only on-screen writing; keep the image free of subtitles, other lettering, logos, watermarks, clutter, and flashing effects.
